description: BASE 9825aba. Root cause of the recurring PLAN_INVALID FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT on delegated opens (live repro: Objective OBJ_dda4ac80 json_transfer planner attempts): two stacked gaps. (1) The canonical planner prompt never listed eligible cross-mission artifacts — the model had to guess input filenames from goal text and picked the output name exports/journal-export.json instead of the real sibling artifact journal.html. (2) The delegated-open planner edge (planExpander → invokePlannerPool) passed externalInputArtifacts=undefined for initial planning, so the pool canonicalizer could not bind ANY cross-mission consume even if the model named it correctly — 'modify existing file' was structurally unplannable on the delegated path. Fix: (a) artifact-handoff.ts gains listEligibleExternalInputSourcesForWorkItem(workItemId) — the SAME canonical sibling scope (allocation → objective → sibling work items → bound missions → ACCEPTED artifacts, identical fail-closed lineage checks) resolved before a consumer Mission/WOB exists; zero allocations returns [] (no scope), >1 fails closed. (b) serve-mission-control.mjs planExpander resolves that set from expandCtx.work_item_id and passes it to invokePlannerPool — feeding BOTH the pool canonicalizer (external_input_artifacts, already parameterized) and (c) the canonical prompt via buildPlannerUserPrompt/codexPlannerPlan: a bounded EXTERNAL INPUT ARTIFACTS block renders each eligible logical name with its source mission/task, plus the rule that consumes may name only an earlier in-plan producer or a listed artifact — never a desired output name. UNBOUND rejection guidance now points at the listed set. Authority unchanged: prompt is context only; pool-stage stamps are re-proven byte-for-byte by bindPlanExternalInputs at mission commit (drift → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_SOURCE_BINDING); absent expandCtx (preview/draft/direct submission) → undefined → identical prior behavior. Tests: W1-W4 work-item-scoped eligibility (allocated-unopened sees sibling set / unallocated → [] / plan-time stamp binds / parity with mission-scoped); E1-E5 prompt contract (render with provenance / consume rule / absent→no block / codex-transport parity / UNBOUND guidance).
